integrity: The proof uses the fully inspected 2026 CHME density, its quoted SME density, and independently derives both survival constants. The unique crossover is proved analytically and checked numerically. Finite computations are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The comparison fixes equal nominal beta and q; matching another functional may change the ordering.
No second-order tail expansion or finite-threshold ordering theorem is claimed.
The original 2017 SME PDF was not fully retrievable during the final comparison, although its exact density is reproduced in the fully inspected 2026 source.
title: CHME and SME share a tail index but have a sharp tail-constant crossover
